{{Quote|I am the Mystic Nelom-Wa. I put the child in the Three. A crying babe. Unfit for everything. To replace a great leader. The vision was clear. The plague came. The Three died. We called back a great leader to reform the Three.|Writings of Nelom-Wa|<ref name="Imp March of Time" />}}
'''Nelom-Wa''' was a [[Voss Mystics|Voss Mystic]] living on [[Voss]] many years before the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was discovered by the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] society. His vision led to replacing a great leader of the [[Three]] with an infant child. This action saved the great leader's life during a plague, allowing him to reform the Three afterwards. Nelom-Wa recorded the event in the [[Writings of Nelom-Wa]] that were etched on a pillar erected outside the [[Shrine of Healing]] in the [[Old Paths]].
